design: Approved Rams editorial. Reconciled with the companion keirdillon.com project on 2026-09-08: adopted its fonts.css (references /assets/fonts/*.woff2 instead of embedding base64 TTF; same five faces) and its brand.css (.tool-format, plus .simple-close .button+.text-action added to an existing selector). All four files are now byte-identical in both projects.

fonts.note: The five faces are identical in both projects because both were extracted from the same preserved base64 source. The .woff2 binaries differ by 8-76 bytes per file because each project used a different WOFF2 encoder. Same glyphs, same metrics, no appearance difference.
